आयुष्मान खुराना और शर्वाणी वाघ स्टारर इस फिल्म का बॉक्स ऑफिस पर है तगड़ा मुकाबला। 🍿
फिल्म को यश राज फिल्म्स के डिस्ट्रिब्यूशन के साथ कुल 7,551 शो मिले हैं। 🎟️
पहले दिन की फाइनल एडवांस बुकिंग में फिल्म ने बिना ब्लॉक सीटों के 68,450 टिकट बेचे हैं। 📊
प्री-सेल्स से फिल्म ने भारत में 1.76 करोड़ रुपये का ग्रॉस कलेक्शन और 1.49 करोड़ रुपये का नेट कलेक्शन किया है। 💰
आयुष्मान की पिछली रिलीज Udta Teer के मुकाबले ये फिल्म एडवांस बुकिंग में 57.14% आगे चल रही है। 🚀

ctx.title: Yeh Prem Mol Liya Box Office Day 1 Advance Booking (Final): Grosses 57% More Than Ayushmann Khurrana’s Udta Teer
ctx.summary:
Ayushmann Khurrana and Sharvari Wagh's Yeh Prem Mol Liya wrapped up its day 1 advance bookings at the Indian box office on a decent note. 
 The post  Yeh Prem Mol Liya Box Office Day 1 Advance Booking (Final): Grosses 57% More Than Ayushmann Khurrana’s Udta Teer  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Yeh Prem Mol Liya, starring Ayushmann Khurrana and Sharvari Wagh, has finally arrived in theaters. Being a Rajshri film, everyone is eager to see how it is received by movie buffs, especially the family audience. Like every Rajshri film, even this one is a word-of-mouth-dependent affair, so one expects it to pick up in the evening and night shows with over-the-counter ticket sales. As far as advance bookings for day 1 are concerned, the film has fetched decent numbers at the Indian box office.
It won’t be wrong to say that it’s going to be a three-way battle at the Indian box office. In addition to this family entertainer, Gunmaaster G9 has also arrived in theaters today. Also, Ramayana is still going strong. As a result, shows have been divided mainly between these three films. Backed by Yash Raj Films’ distribution, the film has managed to get decent showcasing with 7,551 shows. The average ticket price is 261 rupees, which isn’t too high or low.
As per the final day 1 advance booking update, Yeh Prem Mol Liya sold 68,450 tickets (excluding blocked seats) before the first show started. In terms of collections, the film grossed 1.76 crore at the Indian box office through the opening-day pre-sales. In net collections, it equals 1.49 crore . It’s a decent number for a non-holiday release and a word-of-mouth-dependent affair.
Ayushmann Khurrana’s previous release, Udta Teer , raked in 1.12 crore through day 1 advance bookings. If compared with his latest release, Yeh Prem Mol Liya is ahead by 57.14%, grossing 1.76 crore . Considering the clash scenario, the number is acceptable, and now all eyes are on its initial public reactions, as they will determine the film’s growth throughout the day.
Yeh Prem Mol Liya is written and directed by Sooraj Barjatya. It also stars Anupam Kher, Shakti Kapoor, Shaad Randhawa, Supriya Pathak, Seema Pahwa, Swanand Kirkire, Geeta Agarwal Sharma, and Saumya Tandon. It is produced by Kamal Kumar Barjatya, Ajit Kumar Barjatya, and Mahaveer Jain under the banner of Rajshri Productions and Mahaveer Jain Films.
